product_overview: NPI Solar ERP is a ZATCA-native, Arabic/English ERP for solar businesses in Saudi/GCC markets. It supports the core flow from lead to contract, plus finance, procurement, projects, field service, telemetry, PPA settlement, approvals, and administration.
core_goals: Log in and access the ERP workspace
Manage leads, opportunities, and customer records
Create proposals, revise them, and convert approved work into contracts
Track projects, procurement, inventory, and approvals
Issue and manage compliant invoices, payments, and credit notes
Review finance reports and operational dashboards
Handle work orders, assets, telemetry alerts, and PPA settlements
Administer users, roles, permissions, and organization settings

features.name: User Login
features.description: Users sign in with email and password to access the protected ERP workspace.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit the login form -> See the dashboard after successful authentication
Navigate to /login -> Enter invalid credentials -> Submit the login form -> See an error message

features.name: Dashboard KPIs
features.description: Authenticated users view the main KPI dashboard with revenue, project, invoice, and alert summaries.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> View KPI cards and recent activity -> Navigate to other modules from the sidebar

features.name: CRM: Leads, Opportunities, and Customers
features.description: Users manage the sales pipeline by creating leads, converting them into opportunities and customers, and maintaining customer records with VAT validation.
user_flows: Navigate to /leads -> Create a new lead -> See the lead appear in the list
Navigate to /leads -> Open an existing lead -> Convert the lead to an opportunity -> See the related customer and opportunity created
Navigate to /customers -> Create a customer record -> Provide VAT details -> Save the customer -> See the customer in the registry
Navigate to /customers -> Search or filter the customer list -> See matching records only

features.name: Proposals and Contracts
features.description: Users create sales proposals, revise and accept them, then generate and activate contracts with milestones.
user_flows: Navigate to /proposals -> Create a proposal for an opportunity -> Add proposal line items -> Save the proposal -> Open the proposal detail page
Navigate to /proposals/[id] -> Add a revision -> Review the revised proposal -> Accept the revision -> See the proposal marked as accepted
Navigate to /contracts -> Create a contract from an accepted proposal -> Save the contract -> Open the contract detail page
Navigate to /contracts/[id] -> Activate the contract -> Verify a milestone completion -> See the milestone state updated

features.name: ZATCA e-Invoicing
features.description: Users view invoices, issue draft invoices, record payments, create credit notes, and open a printable QR-enabled invoice view.
user_flows: Navigate to /invoices -> View the invoice list and status chips -> Open an invoice detail page
Navigate to /invoices/[id] -> Issue a draft invoice -> See the invoice receive a ZATCA hash chain and issued status
Navigate to /invoices/[id] -> Record a payment against the invoice -> See the outstanding balance reduced
Navigate to /invoices/[id] -> Create a credit note -> See the invoice adjusted accordingly
Navigate to /invoices/[id]/print -> Open the printable invoice view -> See the ZATCA QR code

features.name: Finance Reports
features.description: Users review journal entries and financial reports such as trial balance, income statement, balance sheet, and VAT return.
user_flows: Navigate to /finance -> View journal entries and finance summaries
Navigate to /ledger -> Open the trial balance -> Check that it balances
Navigate to /statements -> Open the income statement -> Open the balance sheet -> Review the financial position
Navigate to /statements -> Generate a VAT return for a period -> Review the returned amounts

features.name: Procurement and Inventory
features.description: Users create vendors, issue purchase orders, approve them, receive goods into stock locations, and review outstanding payables.
user_flows: Navigate to /procurement -> Create a vendor -> Save the vendor record -> See it in the vendor list
Navigate to /procurement -> Create a purchase order with lines -> Save the order -> Open the order detail page
Navigate to /procurement/[id] -> Approve the purchase order -> See the order status updated
Navigate to /procurement/[id] -> Receive goods into a location -> See stock and receipt information updated
Navigate to /payables -> Review outstanding vendor bills and payment status

features.name: Projects (EPC)
features.description: Users view EPC projects, move projects through stages, and create and approve change orders.
user_flows: Navigate to /projects -> View the project list -> Open a project detail page
Navigate to /projects/[id] -> Transition the project stage -> See the new stage reflected in the project
Navigate to /projects/[id] -> Create a change order -> Submit it for approval -> See the change order recorded

features.name: Field Service: Work Orders, Assets, and Warranty
features.description: Users manage work orders through assignment and completion, and review installed assets and warranty-related records.
user_flows: Navigate to /workorders -> Create a work order -> See the work order appear in the list
Navigate to /workorders/[id] -> Assign a technician -> Start the work order -> Add parts -> Complete the work order -> Close the work order
Navigate to /assets -> View installed solar assets -> Review warranty-related asset records

features.name: Telemetry and PPA
features.description: Users monitor solar telemetry, acknowledge alerts, and work with PPA terms and settlement runs.
user_flows: Navigate to /telemetry -> View the telemetry dashboard -> Review production readings and alerts
Navigate to /telemetry -> Open an alert -> Acknowledge the alert -> See the alert status updated
Navigate to /ppa -> Review PPA terms -> Create or review settlement terms -> Run a settlement

features.name: Approvals
features.description: Users review pending approvals and decide to approve or reject documents with comments.
user_flows: Navigate to /approvals -> View the approval inbox -> Open a pending item -> Approve or reject it with a comment -> See the decision recorded

features.name: Admin
features.description: Administrators manage users, roles, permissions, audit logs, and organization settings.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> Create a user and assign a role -> Save the user -> See the new user in the list
Navigate to /admin -> Edit role permissions -> Save the permissions -> See the updated access matrix
Navigate to /admin -> Browse the audit log with filters -> Review matching events
Navigate to /admin -> Update organization settings such as VAT number and address -> Save changes -> See the updated organization details

routes.description: User login page (email + password, JWT auth)
CRM leads list, create and convert leads
Proposal detail with revisions and acceptance
Contract detail, activation, milestones, milestone invoicing
Project detail, stage transitions, change orders
Invoice detail — issue, payments, credit notes, ZATCA QR
Printable invoice view with ZATCA QR code
Finance overview (journal, retention, summary, fiscal periods)
General ledger and trial balance reports
Income statement / balance sheet / VAT return reports
Purchase order detail, approve and receive
Work order lifecycle (assign, start, parts, complete, close)
Installed solar assets and warranty claims
Admin — users, roles, permissions, audit log, org settings

known_limitations.impact: Testing with a restricted role will 403 on admin endpoints

known_limitations.issue: Dev server mode (next dev) — first page compile is slow; initial navigation may take several seconds
known_limitations.impact: Tests may need generous timeouts on first load
